message: The other day, I dug out an old board game from the back of the closet for a family night. As we laughed over the silly rules and shared some snacks, I realized how nice it was to unplug and just enjoy each other’s company. While we chatted, I also thought about our go-bags — it’s good to be prepared, but it’s equally important to create sweet moments like these. Have you found any low-tech fun lately?
